parameters.content:
## 📖 Workflow 5: `@SB_job_manager_bot` Interactive Telegram Controller (Plain-English Guide)

### 🎯 What It Does
This workflow powers your **interactive Telegram remote control (`@SB_job_manager_bot`)**. Every time you tap a button or send a message on Telegram, this workflow responds in under 1 second:
- **Collapsible 3-Drawer Menu**: Lets you check your pipeline, review drafts, and manage portals without cluttering your screen.
- **All 23 Portals & Profile Auto-Complete**: Shows all 23 job portals (Pending vs Authenticated) and lets you tap **`✅ Just Logged In -> Complete Profile`** to sync your Resume, Skills, and EU/AU/Global preferences.
- **Unlearn / Delete Rules**: Lets you delete any individual learned rule or wipe all Resume / Cover Letter rules in 1 tap.
- **Referral Follow-Up Mailer**: Sends real follow-up emails from **`user@example.com`** via SMTP in 1 tap.
- **5-Minute Password Auto-Delete**: Automatically deletes any password you paste in Telegram after 5 minutes for security.

### 🔗 Dependencies (What It Needs to Work)
- **Telegram Webhook**: Receives your button taps and replies from `@SB_job_manager_bot`.
- **Postgres Database & Google Sheets**: Reads/updates your job rows, 23 portal credentials, and learned rules.
- **Gmail 008 SMTP (`user@example.com`)**: Sends live follow-up emails when you click **`📧 Send Follow-Up Mail`**.

### 📥 Input (What Goes In)
- **Trigger**: Instant HTTPS Webhook whenever you tap a button or type a message in `@SB_job_manager_bot`.

### 📤 Output (What Comes Out)
- **Instant Telegram UI Updates**: Updates menus in-place, deletes pasted passwords after 5 minutes, updates Google Sheets/Postgres, sends follow-up emails from `user@example.com`, and triggers Workflows 2, 3, 6, or 7 when needed.

ALTER TABLE portal_credentials_vault ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_cookies TEXT;
ALTER TABLE portal_credentials_vault ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS profile_review_url TEXT;
ALTER TABLE portal_credentials_vault ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS profile_approval_status TEXT DEFAULT 'NOT_FILLED';
ALTER TABLE portal_credentials_vault ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS profile_completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE portal_credentials_vault ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS profile_approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE portal_credentials_vault ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS custom_preferences_note TEXT;

UPDATE portal_credentials_vault
SET profile_review_url = CASE LOWER(site_name)
  WHEN 'naukri' THEN 'https://www.naukri.com/mnjuser/profile'
  WHEN 'linkedin jobs' THEN 'https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/application-settings/'
  WHEN 'wellfound' THEN 'https://wellfound.com/u/edit'
  WHEN 'indeed' THEN 'https://profile.indeed.com/'
  WHEN 'y combinator' THEN 'https://www.workatastartup.com/application'
  WHEN 'naukri gulf' THEN 'https://www.naukrigulf.com/jobseeker/my-profile'
  WHEN 'monster' THEN 'https://www.monster.com/profile/detail'
  WHEN 'hirist' THEN 'https://www.hirist.tech/jobseeker/profile'
  WHEN 'foundit (monster)' THEN 'https://www.foundit.in/seeker/profile'
  WHEN 'times jobs' THEN 'https://www.timesjobs.com/candidate/myprofile.html'
  WHEN 'shine' THEN 'https://www.shine.com/myshine/myprofile/'
  WHEN 'glassdoor' THEN 'https://www.glassdoor.co.in/member/profile/index.htm'
  WHEN 'testgorilla' THEN 'https://app.testgorilla.com/candidate/profile'
  WHEN 'careerbuilder' THEN 'https://www.careerbuilder.com/profile'
  WHEN 'himalayas' THEN 'https://himalayas.app/dashboard/profile'
  WHEN 'weworkremotely' THEN 'https://weworkremotely.com/job-seekers/account/edit'
  WHEN 'remotive' THEN 'https://remotive.com/my-account'
  WHEN 'working nomads' THEN 'https://www.workingnomads.com/users/edit'
  WHEN 'instahyre' THEN 'https://www.instahyre.com/candidate/profile/'
  WHEN 'cutshort' THEN 'https://cutshort.io/profile/candidate-profile'
  WHEN 'jobgether' THEN 'https://jobgether.com/app/profile'
  WHEN 'builtin (remote & india)' THEN 'https://builtin.com/profile'
  WHEN 'remoteok' THEN 'https://remoteok.com/settings'
  ELSE COALESCE(profile_review_url, portal_url)
END
WHERE profile_review_url IS NULL OR profile_review_url = '';

UPDATE portal_credentials_vault
SET profile_approval_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW',
    profile_completed_at = COALESCE(profile_completed_at, NOW())
WHERE LOWER(auth_status) LIKE 'authenticated%'
  AND site_name NOT IN ('Gmail_008_IMAP_SMTP', 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub')
  AND (profile_approval_status IS NULL OR profile_approval_status = '' OR profile_approval_status = 'NOT_FILLED');


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_email_alerts (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  message_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  sender TEXT,
  subject TEXT,
  category TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  snippet TEXT,
  action_taken TEXT,
  received_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS linkedin_activity_log (
  activity_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  activity_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  company_name TEXT,
  insider_name TEXT,
  target_profile_url TEXT DEFAULT '',
  linkedin_url TEXT,
  activity_type TEXT,
  post_snippet TEXT,
  detected_sentiment TEXT,
  reaction_type TEXT,
  content_text TEXT,
  approval_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending Approval',
  rule_scope TEXT DEFAULT 'Standard',
  learned_rule_feedback TEXT DEFAULT '',
  execution_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Awaiting Approval',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

ALTER TABLE linkedin_activity_log ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS target_profile_url TEXT DEFAULT '';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS linkedin_network_contacts (
  contact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  category TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  person_name TEXT,
  target_profile_url TEXT DEFAULT '',
  role_title TEXT DEFAULT '',
  location TEXT DEFAULT '',
  outreach_stage TEXT DEFAULT '',
  connection_note TEXT DEFAULT '',
  latest_post_url TEXT DEFAULT '',
  approval_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending Approval',
  execution_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Awaiting Approval',
  notes_log TEXT DEFAULT '',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS linkedin_daily_stats (
  stat_date DATE PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  connection_requests_sent INT DEFAULT 0,
  follow_requests_sent INT DEFAULT 0,
  follow_requests_accepted INT DEFAULT 0,
  messages_sent INT DEFAULT 0,
  reactions_given INT DEFAULT 0,
  comments_posted INT DEFAULT 0,
  profile_views INT DEFAULT 8,
  easy_applies INT DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO linkedin_daily_stats (stat_date, profile_views)
VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 8)
ON CONFLICT (stat_date) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO learned_rules (section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, is_active)
SELECT 'LinkedIn Post', 'LinkedIn Networking', 'Match post sentiment first (Analytical, Milestone, Serious/Reflective, Hiring); keep comments strictly to 1 short poised sentence (8–18 words), never forced wit.', 'Initial LinkedIn Rule', TRUE
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learned_rules WHERE LOWER(section_name) LIKE '%linkedin%' AND is_active = TRUE);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_ephemeral_messages (
  message_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  chat_id TEXT DEFAULT '8873019272',
  delete_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS master_resume_state (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1,
  drive_file_id TEXT,
  drive_web_link TEXT,
  rules_applied_count INT DEFAULT 0,
  skills_count INT DEFAULT 0,
  certs_count INT DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reference_contacts_cache (
  company_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  referrer_name TEXT,
  referrer_email TEXT,
  referrer_social TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  last_reminded_date DATE,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO reference_contacts_cache (company_name, referrer_name, referrer_email, referrer_social, notes)
VALUES
  ('American Express', 'Bandana / Avneet', '', '', 'Applied via referral (Avneet) - Row #19'),
  ('Axtria', 'Ashish Chandra', 'user@example.com', 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashishchandraiitk/', 'Linkedin request sent. Mail is yet to be sent'),
  ('Nagarro', 'Dhruv Sharma', '', '', 'Reference Sheet Insider'),
  ('Razorpay', 'Neha / Gunjan', '', '', 'Reference Sheet Insider'),
  ('Ev-A - Evolutionary Algorithms', 'Sayyed', '', '', 'Reference Sheet Insider'),
  ('EY', 'Shaurya', '', '', 'Reference Sheet Insider'),
  ('HDFC', 'Chiranjeev Chaterjee', '', '', 'Reference Sheet Insider'),
  ('Nielsen', 'Rishabh Agarwal', '', '', 'Reference Sheet Insider')
ON CONFLICT (company_name) DO UPDATE SET
  referrer_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(reference_contacts_cache.referrer_name, ''), EXCLUDED.referrer_name),
  referrer_email = COALESCE(NULLIF(reference_contacts_cache.referrer_email, ''), EXCLUDED.referrer_email),
  referrer_social = COALESCE(NULLIF(reference_contacts_cache.referrer_social, ''), EXCLUDED.referrer_social);

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(em)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM telegram_ephemeral_messages WHERE deleted = FALSE AND delete_at <= NOW()) em) AS due_ephemeral_msgs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name NOT IN ('Gmail_008_IMAP_SMTP', 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub') ORDER BY site_name ASC) v) AS vault_rows,
  (SELECT row_to_json(g) FROM (SELECT * FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name = 'Gmail_008_IMAP_SMTP' LIMIT 1) g) AS gmail_vault,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name IN ('SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub')) s) AS social_sso_rows,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(l)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM portal_apply_limits ORDER BY site_name ASC) l) AS limit_rows,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(e)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM job_hunter_eod_log ORDER BY id ASC) e) AS eod_logs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(d)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM job_hunter_followup_drafts ORDER BY created_at DESC) d) AS followup_drafts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rc)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM reference_contacts_cache ORDER BY company_name ASC) rc) AS ref_contacts,
  (SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM (SELECT * FROM job_hunter_bot_state WHERE chat_id = '8873019272' LIMIT 1) s) AS bot_state,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS learned_rules_count,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(lr)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, section_name, role_category, rule_instruction FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id ASC) lr) AS all_learned_rules,
  (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM master_resume_state m WHERE id = 1) AS master_resume,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(rule_instruction), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT rule_instruction FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5) lr2) AS recent_rules,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ll)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM linkedin_activity_log ORDER BY CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(activity_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INT) ASC) ll) AS li_logs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(fc)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM linkedin_network_contacts ORDER BY CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(contact_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INT) ASC) fc) AS fh_contacts,
  (SELECT row_to_json(ls) FROM (SELECT * FROM linkedin_daily_stats WHERE stat_date = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 1) ls) AS li_stats,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ea)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM job_hunter_email_alerts ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10) ea) AS email_alerts;
